description: This file defines the EntityCondition interface for building and representing SQL WHERE clause conditions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating various condition expressions, such as comparisons, combinations, and raw SQL fragments, as well as methods for validation, SQL string generation, and entity matching.

methods.name: makeCondition
methods.description: Constructs a condition expression to represent a comparison between two elements, a field and a value, or a combination of conditions.

methods.name: makeConditionDate
methods.description: Creates a condition to filter rows that are currently valid based on date ranges.

methods.name: makeConditionWhere
methods.description: Creates a raw SQL string condition expression.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Checks if the condition matches a specific entity instance.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Validates that the condition expression is valid given the entity model.

methods.name: makeWhereString
methods.description: Generates the SQL WHERE clause string from the condition.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Returns a frozen (immutable) version of the current condition.
